title: A laptop or phone that is lost or stolen
for: A managed device that is no longer in its owner's hands.

steps.title: Confirm with the owner when and where it was last in their hands, and whether it was unlocked
steps.why: Locked and encrypted is a lost asset; unlocked is an incident about everything on it.

steps.title: Send a remote lock from the device manager
steps.why: It costs nothing if the device turns up.
steps.undo: Unlock the device from the device manager once it is back with its owner.

steps.title: Read the device's last reported encryption and screen-lock state
steps.why: This is what decides whether data on it was exposed.

steps.title: Revoke the owner's sessions and the device's certificates
steps.why: A signed-in browser does not need the disk to be decrypted.

steps.title: Send a remote wipe if it will not be recovered
steps.why: A lock can be waited out.

steps.title: Decide, on the incident, whether a breach has likely occurred
steps.why: An unencrypted device holding personal data is one; the clocks run from the decision.

steps.title: Report the theft where the insurer or the law requires
steps.why: Some policies and jurisdictions need a report within days.
